nom: TATCHA The Matcha Foam Pore-Refining & Oil-Balancing Prebiotic Gel Cleanser

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers are strongly positive, repeatedly describing less midday shine, a less clogged T-zone and no stripped feeling; the exception is one reviewer with oily skin who found it pleasant but saw little real difference and does not plan to repurchase.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are mostly positive and say it does not leave them tight or stripped, though one with dry skin cautions that overusing it can strip her skin a little and suggests it suits very oily skin best.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including several with an oily T-zone and drier cheeks, consistently report it controls excess oil while keeping their skin comfortable and balanced, without drying out the drier areas.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some who describe rosacea or acne alongside their sensitivity, consistently report no irritation or breakouts and a gentle, comfortable cleanse.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who names her skin as dry, sensitive and mature calls it a perfect match, reporting a deeply hydrated, calm feel and reduced redness.

concerns.oiliness: Reviewers dealing with oiliness overwhelmingly report less shine and a less oily T-zone through the day, several noting clogged pores looked less noticeable; the one dissenting reviewer, also oily-skinned, felt the effect on her oiliness was not noticeably different from what she expected for the price.
concerns.dehydration: Despite being an oil-control, foaming gel cleanser, the large majority of reviewers say it does not leave skin feeling tight, dry or stripped, several specifically contrasting it with other foaming cleansers that do; one reviewer with dry skin is the exception, cautioning that using too much can strip her skin slightly.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report visibly less redness or a calmer complexion after switching to this cleanser, including ones with rosacea or generally reactive skin; no reviewer reports new redness from using it.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who describe themselves as acne- or blemish-prone consistently report fewer or no new breakouts, and a couple say it helped calm blemishes that were just starting to surface; no reviewer reports it causing breakouts.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer specifically credits the formula with not damaging the skin barrier the way other clarifying washes can; no other reviewer comments on barrier support specifically.

aspects.libelle: Economical, a little goes a long way
Works well as a second, double-cleanse step
Pricey relative to visible results for one reviewer

extraits.texte: I love how foamy this cleanser applies. I have oily skin and it does leave the skin feeling clean and refreshed. However, I didn't see much of a difference gaining my likes. For the price, I would think that it would help. Don't think I will be repurchasing. Gifted by tatcha

gifted by Tatcha. Love Tatcha because it always feels like a whole experience when using their products. This is a very effective gel cleanser that gets rid of all impurities, buildup and oil. I think it's better for someone with really oily skin. I have dry skin so I have to be careful to not over use it otherwise it can strip my skin just a little bit.

This cleanser is fantastic! I adore its natural fragrance. It begins as a green gel and transforms into a white foam with just a small amount of water. A dime-sized amount is sufficient for my entire face once it lathers up. I use it both in the morning and evening, and if I have makeup on, I cleanse twice in succession. It effectively removes my makeup, even though I have oily combination skin that is prone to blemishes. My skin is sensitive as well, yet I haven't experienced any breakouts or irritation. It doesn't leave my face feeling tight or stripped of moisture. Overall, it's a dependable cleanser. I received this product for complimentary from Tatcha, but my views are entirely my own.

I've been really impressed with this cleanser. It leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed without that tight, stripped feeling some cleansers can cause. The gel formula lathers beautifully, and you only need a small amount each time, so the product lasts a while. It does a great job removing makeup, sunscreen, and everyday buildup while still being gentle on my sensitive, rosacea-prone skin. Whether I use it in the morning or at night, my skin feels soft, balanced, and comfortable afterward. gifted by Tatcha

​Five stars for the Tatcha Cleansing Gel! It is the perfect match for my dry, sensitive, mature skin. The unique gel to creamy foam texture cleanses gently without stripping away moisture, leaving my face feeling soft, calm, and deeply hydrated. It's incredibly soothing, clears up redness, and offers amazing value for the results. If you want a gentle, moisturizing cleanser that pampers your skin, this is it! Complimentary from Tatcha.

The Matcha Foam Cleanser by Tatcha is a great discovery especially because of my oily skin and large clogged pores. The formula lathers nicely and helps to unclog my pores and remove excess sebum. I like that the formula is fragrance-free and also without harsh chemicals. My skin feels hydrated, calmer, and less oily. gifted by tatcha

Gifted by Tatcha. I have been using this product for a week now and noticed a significant difference in my skin. My skin is fairly oily but has areas of dry patches. This cleanser has helped removed oils from my skin. It leaves my skin feeling refreshed and smooth. This product helped reduce my redness.
